script: That is per-task pay. If the bakery then asks her to look after its social media every month for a set fee, that is a retainer. The kind of work is the same, but the way you are paid changes the way you plan your time. Before you accept any job, ask how you will be paid, and how long the work will really take. Think of your progress as a learning loop. Each job teaches you something, each review makes your profile stronger, and each stronger profile brings a better job. The loop is slow at first, but it speeds up. Work also comes in waves, so keep looking for clients even when you are busy. And some offers are scams. In chapter ten, you will learn exactly how to spot them.
